findings.title: Significant class imbalance remains
findings.statement: The dataset exhibits a class imbalance with a ratio of 4.31 between the largest and smallest classes, where triangles represent only 13.0% of the 100 images analyzed.
findings.recommendation: Apply class weighting during training or perform data augmentation on the minority classes.

findings.title: Data quality score improved after cleaning
findings.statement: The overall data quality score increased from 52.4 to 91.6 out of 100 following the removal of corrupt, duplicate, and low-quality images.
findings.recommendation: Continue monitoring the quality score if additional data is added to the training set.

findings.title: Removal of corrupt and low-quality images
findings.statement: Cleaning processes removed 23 images from the original 123, including 3 corrupt files, 9 blurry images, and 1 image that was too small.
findings.recommendation: Ensure future data ingestion pipelines include validation checks for resolution and blurriness.

findings.title: Cross-class label contamination resolved
findings.statement: The raw dataset contained 4 files duplicated across different classes, which were successfully identified and removed during the cleaning process.
findings.recommendation: Maintain the current cleaning pipeline to prevent future label leakage.

findings.title: AI-flagged potential mislabels
findings.statement: An AI vision review identified 5 suspected mislabels, specifically noting square-shaped images potentially incorrectly categorized within the circles folder, which require human verification.
findings.recommendation: Manually audit the flagged images and reassign them to the correct class folder if necessary.

findings.title: Inconsistent image modes and transparency
findings.statement: The dataset contains 2 images with transparency (RGBA) and 1 grayscale image (L), which may require consistent preprocessing to RGB before training.
findings.recommendation: Convert all images to a uniform RGB format during the data loading pipeline.

findings.title: Images require EXIF rotation
findings.statement: Two images were identified as requiring EXIF rotation to ensure correct orientation for the model.
findings.recommendation: Apply EXIF orientation correction to these images before training.

narrative.headline: Dataset quality improved to 91.6/100 after cleaning, but class imbalance and minor labeling issues remain.
narrative.executive_summary: Data cleaning raised the quality score from 52.4 to 91.6 out of 100 by removing 23 images from the original 123. The final dataset of 100 images contains a class imbalance with a ratio of 4.31, where triangles account for only 13.0%. Additionally, an AI review flagged 5 potential mislabels in the circles folder, and preprocessing will need to handle 2 images with transparency and 1 grayscale image.
next_steps: Verify and correct the 5 AI-flagged suspected mislabels in the circles folder.
Address the class imbalance where triangles represent only 13.0% of the 100 images analyzed.
Standardize the 2 images with transparency (RGBA) and 1 grayscale image (L) to RGB format.
Apply EXIF rotation to the 2 images requiring correct orientation before training.
